Receiving countries show various reactions. Some welcome immigrants, others reject them.
Politicians often turn this issue into a political point of dispute.
The challenges that immigrants pose are multiple language, culture, religion and economy.
Friction between the receiving society
And new immigrants may occur
But looking back at the history of immigration
We see that they have made many contributions
To their receiving countries
The prosperity of America
Was built by immigrants from around the world
There is also wide variation
Among immigrants, some move

Some flee war, or persecution as refugees
